title: This session is being written by another process
description: To prevent concurrent writes from corrupting the JSONL session, this view is now read-only.
staleDescription: An abandoned or expired session lease was found. Restoring write access still requires your explicit confirmation.
takeoverRisk: A forced takeover immediately revokes the original process. A process that does not support this lease protocol may still write, so confirm that the original task has stopped.
readOnlyBanner: Another process owns write access to this session. You can browse history, but cannot send messages or modify the session.
sendBlocked: Send blocked: another process owns this session. Your draft was restored.

reasons.same-host-live-pid: The process is still alive on this host
reasons.cross-host-fresh: Another host has a fresh heartbeat
reasons.invalid-record: The lease file is corrupt or invalid
